# Interferon response partial fabrication variant E

ISG expression profiling showed selective induction. IFI6 was upregulated (Table 1). ISG15 was upregulated (Table 1). MX1 was upregulated (Table 1). OAS1 was downregulated (Table 1). IFI44 was upregulated (Table 1). STAT1 was upregulated (Table 1). TNF was upregulated (Table 1).
